Makes call recording more resistant to interruptions.

string-array.item: Keep or delete: CallVault can ask after each call whether to keep the recording (Settings ▸ Recording)
Share a recording, or just a selected part of it
Call history: every call from your phone's log, next to its recording
Your own file-name format, and an optional label for which SIM each call used
Calls placed through Google Voice keep the number you dialled
Shizuku mode: the microphone no longer stays on after a call, and no crash when the recorder restarts
Honor phones that pause CallVault during a call record more reliably
Drive: recordings are no longer lost when the Drive folder is also the recordings folder
When a call was not recorded because CallVault had been force-stopped, the card says so
